title: Lab overview
purpose: See laboratory attention counts and open operational lists.

sections.title: Access and navigation
paragraphs: Available to active signed-in lab staff with an admin, custodian, analyst, reviewer, approver or project manager role. Client accounts and accounts without a lab role cannot open laboratory pages. Sidebar links open Lab overview, Inventory, Equipment, Training and Nonconformances. Breadcrumbs return to the list or parent record.

items.label: Look ahead
items.description: Choose 7, 14, 30, 60 or 90 days; blank and explicit 30 mean 30 days. This display window does not define expiry dates or lab policy. Default and invalid values use 30 days. Choosing a window changes nothing until you press Apply, which reloads the counts and links for that window.

items.label: Expired, still on hand
items.description: Active lots with expiry before today and positive stock. Opens the expired-stock list.

items.label: Expiring within … days
items.description: Active lots with positive stock and expiry from today through the horizon inclusive. Opens that filtered list.

items.label: Calibration or maintenance overdue
items.description: Non-retired assets with either latest uncorrected due date before today.

items.label: Due within … days
items.description: Non-retired assets with either due date from today through the horizon inclusive. An asset can count here and as overdue if its other event kind is overdue.

items.label: In service with no due date recorded
items.description: In-service assets with neither calibration nor maintenance due dates; one missing date alone does not qualify.

items.label: Past due
items.description: Nonclosed records with due date before today; today is not past due.

items.label: Assigned to me
items.description: Nonclosed records whose owner is you. Each row opens its matching filtered list.

items.label: My records expiring within … days
items.description: Your Current records expiring by the horizon, excluding qualifying renewed records.

items.label: My expired records not yet renewed
items.description: Your Expired records without an acceptable, effective, uncorrected renewal.

items.label: All staff: expiring or expired, not renewed
items.description: Admin, reviewer, approver and project manager roles see this total for all staff. Includes Current records expiring by the horizon and Expired records without qualifying renewals.

sections.title: Destination limits
paragraphs: Counts use the deployment local date and current records, not historical qualification or compliance checks. Zero means none. Training links open the combined Expiring or expired filter with no staff filter: lead roles land on all staff even for My cards. The expired-record link uses the list default 30-day horizon and therefore also includes soon-expiring records.
